_om: Sfinksen in English (Sphinx, rusj.no/en/sphinx/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. A «gåte» is a riddle; «Gjengen» is playing as a group, «Alene» on your own. The riddles are our own, in data.en/gater.json, written for the UK.
Gåter med en vri: Les nøye, tenk deg om: Riddles with a twist: read carefully and think – the answer is often simpler than you expect.
Én leser kortet for gjengen. Les det to: One person reads the card to the group. Read it twice – the catch is often in the words.
Den første som sier riktig svar, får poe: The first to say the right answer gets the point. Stuck? Tap ‘Hint’ – first you get the number of letters, then the first letters.
Trykk «Vis svaret» og så på den som klar: Tap ‘Show the answer’ and then whoever got it first. After 10 or 20 riddles come the results.
Alene? Velg «Alene» og si ærlig om du kl: On your own? Choose ‘Solo’ and be honest about whether you got it. The phone remembers your record.
Hint koster ingenting. «Barn» passer fra: Hints are free. ‘Kids’ suits ages 7 and up; ‘Brain teasers’ are the toughest.
Et svar som betyr det samme, teller. Det: An answer that means the same thing counts. It's the thought that matters.
Trykket feil? «Angre» tar poenget tilbak: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo’ takes the point back.
Swipe the card away for a new riddle.
Etter {n} gåter ser du hvor mange du kla: After {n} riddles you’ll see how many you got.
Etter {n} gåter kommer kåringen av seg s: After {n} riddles the results come up by themselves.
Hvordan vil dere spille?: How do you want to play?
Alle gjetter – først riktig får poenget: Everyone guesses – first right answer wins the point
Gjett selv og slå rekorden din: Guess on your own and beat your record
Every single one! The Sphinx bows to you.
Well done! You saw straight through the tricks.
Noen satt langt inne. Prøv igjen – de bl: Some were tricky. Try again – they get easier once you know the tricks.
Well done! The sharpest of the lot.
Gåtene vant denne gangen. Prøv med hint!: The riddles won this time. Try the hints!
You’ll see how many you’ve got so far.
You’ll go straight to the results.
Jeg klarte {riktig} av {av} gåter i {spi: I solved {riktig} of {av} riddles in {spill}. Can you beat that? 🦁
